subject.title: ci: add unsigned iOS build workflow

question: Should OpenClaw core own a manually dispatched unsigned iOS archive workflow once the security hardening blockers are fixed?
rationale: The code defects are mechanically fixable, but accepting a new artifact-producing macOS workflow is an infrastructure ownership choice that green CI alone does not settle.

options.title: Harden Then Reassess Core Ownership
options.body: Fix the dispatch-input and token-hardening blockers first, rerun the archive proof, then let the workflow owner decide whether to merge the lane.

options.title: Keep It As Fork-Only Proof
options.body: Close or pause the core PR if maintainers do not want OpenClaw to publish unsigned iOS archives from repository Actions.

options.title: Accept As Maintainer-Owned Infra
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the new lane after documenting who owns the artifact lifecycle and operational cost.

recommendation.title: Harden Then Reassess Core Ownership
recommendation.body: Fix the dispatch-input and token-hardening blockers first, rerun the archive proof, then let the workflow owner decide whether to merge the lane.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workflow hardening and CI setup history makes this the best available owner for the workflow-security direction.
